translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Jesús aga e-chapinganga nag enukchad

Teun Pab-Najad-Itoged-Ibe pan-kuele, Jesús pato wiis ega wilubgan noni iti-nap ebegal, nikpa e-Pabbak mes megnegal. Tenal Jesús tule-iti-napkin-ebal-nanimalad-pilalgus. Tenal Jesús pela-pela aga e-chapingan-pilalgus e-purkwijadzhe.
Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganbak chedokí mas kunchiun, nia Simón-machi-Judas-Iscariotegin pato togzha Jesúsgin-akpingal.
Tenal Jesús wiis, e-Pab ega igal-ukcha pel-kwapa immal imagal. Tenal Jesús wisbaldo, ede Pab-Tummad-akar noni, tegin ede kannan Pab Tummadzhe nebal.
Tegin Jesús mas-kunchiid-akar kwisgudgu, aga chuba echus. Tegin Jesús toalla amiapku, aga muchil-abal toalla etis.
Tegin Jesús pardegin ti eyosgu, aga e-chapinganga nag enukalzhun. Tegin Jesús muchilgin-toalla-etilenaidgin aga e-chapinganga nag elisbal.
Tegin Jesús Simón-Pedro-nag-enukchogalgu, Pedro Jesúsga chogal: —¿Tummad, pe anka nag enuknemoyé? ¡Chulá!
Tegin Jesús Pedroga chogal: —Imi an-pega-nag-enuked ampa pe aku-ito an ibi pegin imanai. Tenal pe kujal kep mag itononiko.

Tegin Pedro Jesúsga chogalbal: —Tummad, an meke-igi pega igal-kwen-uknejul, pe anka nag enukkal. Tegin Jesús Pedroga chogal: —Imi pe anka igal-kwen-ukchulil an pega nag enukkal, pe anpal-naid-tulejul.
Tegin Simón-Pedro Jesúsga chogalbal: —Tummad, imi pe teob chogel, tegil pe melle an-nagbi enukodo. Tenal an-chunkalzhe tegin an-nonoje-pakal pe anka enuko an pega oyogal, an chunchunnad pebal nai.

Tenal Jesús Pedroga chogal: —Imi tule-obzhamalad pato obed-wilubzhulmal. We tulemal pel-kwapa enukal-nemal, e-nagbi enuked-wilubmal. Tenal pemal pato chwilidik-nemal. Tenal pemal-abalgin tule-walgwen ampa iskued nika.
¿Tenal Jesús, ibiga weob chogzha pe ebinzhe? Imi teun Jesús pato wisdo, toa-tule egin akpinnonikoedde. Al Jesús chognoni: “Pemal-pel-kwapa chwilidik-nejulmal.”

Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga pel-kwapa nag enusgu, aga kannan chuba yosbal. Tegin Jesús mesaje kannan chignadbal. Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga chogalbal: —¿Imi an pemalga nag enukchad, ibi chogle-wede? Tegin e-chapingan Jesúsga chogal: —Anmalde wichí.
Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga nuekwa palchogalzhun: “Nabir. Imi pemal anche kolmal: ‘Tummad’ tegin ‘Tule-oturdaked.’ Wedin ib-nued. Antin ádo.
Imi antin ‘Tummad,’ tegin antin ‘Tule-oturdaked.’ Tenal antin pemalga yabli nag enusmal tule-pinchegadyob. Tenal an pemalga imis nag-enukchadyob, pemal aga muchub-muchub nag-enukedgin naneenabmalmo.
“Tenal an pemalga chagla chis, pemal aga emal-emal pentamalgal, an pemalga imajadyob.
Tenal an chunchunnad pemalga chogdo: imi tule-pinche-arpaged meke-igi e-ibedga pul tule-tummad chul. Teginbal, tule-palmilegalid meke-igi tule-e-palmialidga, pul tule-tummad chulmo.
“Tenal an-imis-pemal-oturdajad pemal mag itononikidbal, tegin an-pega-chogzhad-yopí pe nanebi-kualil, Pab Tummad pega immal-nuegan imanoniko.
“Tenal an pemalgin-pel-kwapa chunmajul. Tenal an wisdo, an toamala-chus. ¿Ibiga an weob pemal-chus pe ebinzhe? Nabir. Imi akpene Pab-kartagin nermakal-maidyob kunonigal. Tenal Pab-kartagin chogdo:
“Tenal an pemalga iktualeba chogdo. Tenal an-pemalga-chogzhiidyob anka kunonikil, pe ankin ibzhenoniko, antin Pab-an-palmialid-tule.
Tenal an chunchunnad pemalga chogdo: meke-ibi-tule an-tule-palmialid-abingeel, we tule pato an-abingasmo. Tegin tule an-abingajal, pato Pab-an-palmialid-abingasmo.”
Jesús chogzhagujad Judas egin akpinnoniko
Tegin Jesús pél chunmasgu, aga ulubgin pela-pela nunma-itononi. Tegin Jesús aga e-chapinganga nuekwa palchogalzhun: —Imi an chunchunnad pemalga chogdo: imi pemal-walgwen ankin akpinnoniko.
Tegin e-chapingan Jesús-chogzhad itosmalgu, weob pakal pesmal. Tegin Jesús-e-chapingan nue aga emal-emal takalmal, Jesúsde toagin chogzha-dewa.
Tenal teun takalgu, Jesús-e-chapin-pul-pilaled-Juan, Jesús-waglika mas kunchii.
Al Simón-Pedro kakagin Juanga wilub imas, Jesúszhe ekisgal, Jesúsde toagin chogzha, egin akpinnoniko.
Tegin Juan Jesús-ua-nabal Jesúszhe ekichialzhun: —¿Tummad, pe toagin chogzha-ade, pegin akpinnoniko?

Tegin Jesús Juanga chogalzhun: —Imi an masgin madu wartichajal, tegin an we tulega madu ukchal, a-tule ankin akpinnonikoed. Tegidgin Jesús masgin madu wartichasgu, Simón-machi-Judas-Iscariotega madu-ukcha.
Tegin Judas Jesúsgin madu chusgu, nia-Satanás Judasgin tognoni. Tegin Jesús Judasga chogalzhun: —Imi pe immal imaneed, pe kueye imanaddo.
Tenal e-chapingan-Jesúsbak-mes-mesagin-pukmalad aku-itomal, Jesúsde ibiga Judasga weob chogzha: “Pe nao.”

Tenal teun takalgu, Judas Jesúsmalga mani-chaboedga kudii-choggu, al Jesús-e-chapingan ebinzhasmal, Jesúsde Judasga chogzha, itogedga immal paknegal. O chulil, ebinzhasmalbal, Jesús Judasga chogzha, tule-wilemaladga mani uknegal.
Tegin Judas madu-ka-uklejad kuchagu, ilgwen nod. Tenal teun neg pato mutik.
Jesús chogzhagujad e-chapingan aga muchub-muchub pilalguenabmal
Tegin Judas-naded-cholbal, Jesús aga e-chapingan-pimaladga chogal: “Imi an-Te-Tule-Chunna-nug-okannoleged-wilub pato noni. Tegin an-Te-Tule-Chunnabal, Pab-Tummad-nug-okannolenonimogo.
Tenal an-Te-Tule-Chunnabal Pab-Tummad-nug-okannolenonikil, Pab Tummad an-Te-Tule-Chunna-nug-okannononimogo. Tenal Pab Tummad imis-imis an-Te-Tule-Chunna-nug-okannogo.”

Tegin Jesús chogalbal: “An-machimal, imi an pemalbak iché napi wis kudii. Tenal an akpene Judiomalga chogzhado: ‘Pemal an-amialmalal, an-kwen-onogojulmal.’ Tenal an Judiomalga-chogzhad-yopí an pemalga chogmodo. Tenal pemal an-amialmalal, an-kwen-onogojulmal. Tegin pemal imis-imis an-togoed-negzhe kwen togojulmalmo.”
Tegin Jesús chogalbal: “Imi antin imis-akar pemalga igal-pin-mesne, pemal aga muchub-muchub pilalgumalo. Tenal an pemal-pilalgujadyob pemal aga muchub-muchub pilalguenabmalmo.
“Tenal pemal aga muchub-muchub pilalgunonimalal, tulemal-pel-kwapa mag pemal-taknonimalo, pemal chunchunnad anpal-turdasmalad-tulemal.”
Tegin Simón-Pedro Jesúszhe ekichial: —¿Tummad, pia pe ne-ade? Tegin Jesús Simón-Pedroga chogal: —Imis an-needzhe, keg anpak pe neel. Tenal kujaldin pe akalzhul an-cholbal nemogo.
Tegin Pedro Jesúsga chogalbal: —¿Tummad, ibiga keg an imis pebak ne-ade? Antin, an kuakwa kudii, pega purkwegal.
Tegin Jesús Pedroga chogal: —¿Pe kuakwa kudií, anka purkwegalá? Chulá. Imi an chunchunnad pega chogdo: ampayo kallin-mastad namakeddu, pedin ilapá ankin chogo: ‘Antin Jesús-kwen-wichul.’
